key_points: Cleveland-Cliffs committed $1bn to modernize Middletown Works, half funded by DOE grant.
Upgrade aims to improve efficiency, lower emissions, and support long-term competitiveness.
Analysts debate whether the spend justifies current valuation; some see undervaluation.
Stock dipped ~2% on Sep 18 amid broader market moves, but news flow is largely positive.
GLJ Research maintains $15 price target, indicating upside from current levels.
